verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
[✲]By the angels who are sent forth with goodness,
w: by the angels who are sent forth

verses.en: [✲]And then they push on with a forceful pushing,
[✲]And by the forces that spread the truth, a good spreading,
w: and by the forces that spread the truth

verses.en: [✲]And then they distinguish fully between good and evil.
[✲]Then they carry the exhortation far and wide
[✲]To excuse some and warn others.
Verily, that which you are promised must come to pass.
So when the stars are made to lose their light,
And when the heaven is rent asunder,
And when the mountains are blown away,
And when the Messengers are made to appear at the appointed time —
w: are made to appear at the appointed time

verses.en: For what day has the time of these happenings been appointed?
w: has the time of these happenings been appointed

verses.en: For the Day of Decision.
And what should make thee know what the Day of Decision is! —
Woe on that day unto those who reject the truth!
Did We not destroy the earlier peoples?
We will now cause the later ones to follow them.
w: We will cause to follow them

verses.en: Thus do We deal with the guilty.
Woe on that day unto those who reject the truth!
Did We not create you from an insignificant fluid,
And We placed it in a safe place,
For a known measure of time?
Thus did We measure, and how excellently do We measure!
Woe on that day unto those who reject the truth!
Have We not made the earth so as to hold
The living and the dead?

verses.ar: وَّجَعَلۡنَا فِیۡہَا رَوَاسِیَ شٰمِخٰتٍ وَّاَسۡقَیۡنٰکُمۡ مَّآءً فُرَاتًا ﴿ؕ۲۸﴾
verses.en: And We placed thereon high mountains, and gave you sweet water to drink.
Woe on that day unto those who reject the truth!

verses.ar: اِنۡطَلِقُوۡۤا اِلٰی مَا کُنۡتُمۡ بِہٖ تُکَذِّبُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۳۰﴾
verses.en: ‘Now move on towards that which you treated as a lie,

verses.ar: اِنۡطَلِقُوۡۤا اِلٰی ظِلٍّ ذِیۡ ثَلٰثِ شُعَبٍ ﴿ۙ۳۱﴾
verses.en: ‘Aye, move on towards a shadow which has three sections,

verses.ar: لَّا ظَلِیۡلٍ وَّلَا یُغۡنِیۡ مِنَ اللَّہَبِ ﴿ؕ۳۲﴾
verses.en: ‘Neither affording shade, nor protecting from the flame.’
[✲]It throws up sparks like huge castles,
[✲]As if they were camels of dim colour.
Woe on that day unto those who reject the truth!
This is a day when they shall not be able to speak;
Nor shall they be permitted to offer excuses.
Woe on that day unto those who reject the truth!
‘This is the Day of Decision; We have gathered you and all the earlier peoples together.
w: and all the earlier peoples together

verses.en: ‘If now you have any stratagem, use it against Me.’
Woe on that day unto those who reject the truth!
The righteous will be in the midst of shades and springs,
And fruits, such as they will desire.

verses.ar: کُلُوۡا وَاشۡرَبُوۡا ہَنِیۡٓــًٔۢا بِمَا کُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ ﴿۴۴﴾
verses.en: ‘Eat and drink pleasantly as a reward for what you did.’
Thus surely do We reward those who do good.
Woe on that day unto those who reject the truth!
‘Eat and enjoy yourselves a little while in this world, O rejectors of truth; surely you are the guilty ones.’
Woe on that day unto those who reject the truth!

verses.ar: وَاِذَا قِیۡلَ لَہُمُ ارۡکَعُوۡا لَا یَرۡکَعُوۡنَ ﴿۴۹﴾
verses.en: And when it is said unto them, ‘Bow down,’ they do not bow down.
Woe on that day unto those who reject the truth!
In which word then, after this, will they believe?
